$comment: C11/C23 6.7.5 (D-CSUBSET-ALIGNAS-OVERALIGNED-STACK-LOCAL): the MEMBER-alignas route — a stack local whose declaration carries no `alignas` at all, but whose TYPE is raised to 32-byte alignment by an alignment specifier on one member. It travels a different channel (`CompositeFields.fieldAligns` → the computed layout alignment → the alloca's effective alignment) than a declaration-site `alignas`, and a fix that read only the declaration would compile this and silently under-align it. The struct spans several frame slots, so the headroom is added after a MULTI-slot span. Checks: `&s & 31 == 0`, a following local read back intact, and two fields of the struct itself read back intact. exit = 42. Red-on-disable: zero `frameSlotAlignHeadroom` or drop the `emitAlignUpToPowerOfTwo` call in `emitLeaFrameSlot` and this returns 1. One exit code across all four targets incl. the shipped release pipeline.
